text: We absolutely love Tito's! Amazing food and the staff is always so friendly! Definitely would recommend!

Really good, fresh pizza. They are constantly making new pizza and replenishing for the display. I love being able to buy by the slice. There are also other options like calzones, salad, little desserts. Overall great spot for quick dinner or late night.

Ordered chicken shawarma entree, it comes with rice by default. However, when I opened the container at home, there were RAW French fries. A TON of them. One more raw than the other one. So... they not only sent whatever they wanted to (fries are not even an option for the dish) but they sent them raw. See the pictures for better reference. 

Also, I got Kibbeh, which is my favorite thing to order from this type of food. To my surprise, it was raw? I never ever had a Kibbeh with such a juicy soggy texture inside. I uploaded the picture so you can (try) to understand what I'm talking about.

I called the place to complain around 8:45PM, no answer. They claim their business hours are until 9PM. 

What a bad experience. Won't order from this place ever again. 1 star is too generous.

This is your classic old school dive bar. Worn wooden floors, darkened room and a belly-up-to-the-bar ambiance. Wide selection of beers and, I'm sure, classic mixed drinks. Truly great breaded tenderloin on brioche bun and outstanding, incredible onion rings. Pizza comes in 3 sizes (7-10-14) and was excellent on a crisp thin crust (though no anchovies or green olives).   Outdoor sidewalk dining and table service was a plus.  Right on the red line so easy access.

Panera Bread is one of the better fast food choices. The pastries are delicious and large! The bagels are good. On Tuesdays the bagels $6.99 for a Baker's dozen (13). This is a great deal! I'm a tea drinker. I was a little disappointed because the tea wasn't strong even using 2 bags. 
Panera is a good option for lunch though. There are lots of salads, soups, and sandwiches. The salads are good. You can have them with or without chicken. I like the salad and soup combo with 1/2 a sandwich and a smaller salad. You can definitely get a healthy lunch here! 
The store was clean and spacious with booth and table seating. There's a wall of windows that let in lots of natural light.  The young man who took my order at 6:45 am was pleasant and helpful.

Had dinner last night and unfortunately was very underwhelmed. Sat at the bar, we had a reservation, but the table wasn't ready. Bartenders were very friendly but service was lacking. We had to ask for drinks and ask to order, food service was very slow. The kitchen ran out of a couple items we wanted to order, so they made substitutions which were just ok.  The food was bland and very pricey. Unfortunately won't be returning.

This is a solid coffee shop with a lot of options. I tried the iced caramel mocha latte and my husband tried the iced mint mocha - both were really good and pretty sweet (which I like but I know some people don't care for, so watch out). 
My favorite thing about the drink is that the coffee flavor shined through. It tasted like a coffee chocolate milk. Refreshing and tasty on a hot Indiana day!
We noticed after ordering that there are a lot of drink options with honey in them - I probably would have tried one of those had I seen the sign before ordering so I'm looking forward to coming back and trying out some more drinks!

The service was kind and quick, too!
In short - it seems like you can't go wrong here.

Best chicken tenders EVER. High quality food. Flavor is out of this world. I also had a side of slaw and fries w/fry sauce (they call it something else. The fry sauce reminds me of our time living in Utah. The workers treated my husband and I like family. They were very helpful. We had a very positive experience and will be back again for sure.

Quality B Dubs: clean, solid service, good ambiance, inexpensive, cold beer, wings are A++. Really good for kids too - so long as you're not looking for anything healthy (BWW ain't the place for that). One of my go tos in the area, always enjoy it here!

Meh. Ok, so I'm from California and I think most Mexican food across the south is not as expected. But a placed called California tacos, I was told they are street tacos, sounded like a safe bet. But... not so much. 

First I wanted carne asada tacos... this location doesn't make carne asada. Ok. Plan B I tried what they call a rolled taco. Um... turns out in Florida a "rolled taco" is what we in Cali call a taquito. So that was disappointing. But, trying to stay open minded I tried the taquito. Nope. Not a good one. I've had the Lisa day over my lifetime from scads of places. This was bland chicken and way over cooked as far as the tortilla goes. Chips were the same way over cooked and low to salt so they just tasted like burnt masa. Now off to the pico de gallo they call their salsa,  pretty good, at least they tried w pico instead of the cooked jar salsa that is so prevalent in the South, but not on par w legit hole in the wall joints in OC or LA where foodies gather. 
 
My husband ordered a pork burrito. It was a hefty thing, rolled and no sauce so that seemed legit. He said the pork had good flavor, but the addition of what he called some form of cole slaw was not really appreciated. Not legit at all. 

After we ate I was shocked outta my mind to find out this place was on Drive Ins Diners and Dives?  Forreal? Was this a long time ago or did I order way off the page from what they do well?!?  Hopefully we were there on an off day...
Got the tacos and big kahuna. Took us back to the islands. The food was ono! Atmosphere too!

Bruh. This was the best sandwich I've ever eaten in my entire life hands down... and I'm from the philly metro area, which means I've had guads. If I had the ability to give this restaurant my left ball. I would.

My husband and I decided to go to this establishment because of the reviews. This is a tiny little, hole in the wall place. I am a vegetarian for many years and ordered a vegan Italian sausage sausage with giardiniera. Oh my word that was fantastic. I would not expect a slight curry flavor, but I LOVE curry. Hubby says crispy bacon, melted cheese yum. One of my new fave beach spots. Will be back.

On our way to the airport we decided to hit up the Metro Diner. It was just after 1 PM on a Tuesday and this place was still hoppin. It's been a while since I've been in a good diner.  Matter of fact, this is hands down the best modern diner we've been lucky enough to dine. Quick, friendly service right from the get go. Our food came out pretty fast for how big the menu is and let me say, the portions were huge! What a value! I sure I hope I get the chance to come back... so much more good food to try!

This was an AMAZING dining experience. I recommend making a reservation although Tony will move mountains to get people seated. Aside from the fantastic service, the food was exquisite and the wine/drink list expansive. Our server was Ray and he suggested the tuna and salmon for entrees and they did not disappoint. Truly a gastronomic delight. Vincent's is a must try.

First time here and will definitely go back.

We started with the spinach artichoke dip and it was very good and the serving size was large.  The same can be said about everything we ordered. The deluxe pizza was great! The Pasta Con Broccoli was "creamy and flavorful," and the Chicken Modiga was "juicy with a rich sauce" and it came with fresh, tender green beans. All three of us took enough food home for another meal.

We used to eat at this outback at least once or twice a week because it is close to our home and we like the food. We will not be returning to that outback because of the service we received on our last visit. The waiter that we had refused to wear a mask properly. We asked him to please pull his mask up so it covered his mouth and nose and he refused saying that his mask would not pull up. We complained to the manager and saw that she had taken him aside and assumed that she spoke to him. He was removed from waiting on our table and we were given a new server who was wearing her mask. The waiter we had was then waiting on the table next to us with his face covered but he then walked by our table and fully pulled his mask down as he walked by out table. I understand that he doesn't want to wear a mask but this is no way to treat customers. We wear masks in restaurants, except when eating and drinking. We wear masks out wherever we go. It is inconvenient but we want to care for ourselves and others. We were not trying to be mean or rude by asking our waiter to wear a mask. We would not have spoken to the managers if he had just pulled the mask up when we first asked. We started by suggesting that his mask had accidentally fallen below where it should be and then we just outright asked him to pull his mask up.  He heard those requests as well as our discussion with the manager. People who serve food should take better care. For the sake of their customers. Our food was good whe

Look. The spice is something serious. I love me some spicy food but anything past level 3 here is a suicide mission. I get my drunken noodles at a level 2 and it's perfect. You can still taste some flavor while the spice hits you. I tried some basil fried rice at a level 3 and almost lost my hearing lol. I could feel the spice burning my ears. I've also had pad Thai at level 2 and it seemed to be hotter than my level 2 drunken noodles. It was still tasty though. I venture here every now & then for lunch & end up having lunch for like the next two days lol. The portions are humongous. One plate is definitely enough for two. I love how generous they are with veggies. Mushrooms, carrots, bell pepper, Chinese broccoli, onion, etc. are loaded into your dish. I also love to get a big ole Thai tea. Every now & then it's a little too sweet but I just add a little water. The prices are great especially considering you get enough food to do meal prep lol. It's always pretty quiet there but always has a few people. It's clean and the service is good too. If you're a fan of Thai food, you should definitely

I loved the atmosphere and airiness of Burlap and Bean.  The decaf cappuccino was delicious (they have Swiss process decaf!) and the staff was friendly.  The avocado toast also hit the spot. And, what's particularly great is that I had left a sweater there and they went out of their way to quickly ship it back to me in Boston!  Overall, a terrific place ...I hope I have a chance to visit again soon.

One word- avoid. Worst option on the Hill. Food is sub par. Took 5 people for dinner and all five entrees were terrible.  The calamari was rubber, the risotto uncooked, the chicken parmigiana fried to death.

Food- amazing. Service- amazing. 
The Crispy Brussel Sprouts were mind-blowing, subtle then sweet, omg phenomenal! The Ricotta and Fig Toast was SO fancy, very instagram worthy and delicious! Ruby Slippers is totes my new favorite drink and Corey answered all my questions and had amazing recommendations. 
The music really didn't match the atmosphere though?
Fantastic dinner *chefs kiss*
If you have eaten in California and miss the Asian cuisine from the west coast look no further because this place will blow your mind. Best fresh wonderful seafood . Will be back

Great Taco's!!  and the Chile Relleno oh so good!. Met up with my friend for dinner tonight and we both enjoyed our dinner and the margaritas she had was good.  She shared it with me.    The chips and salsa were plenty and they kept filling our bowl with more chips.  We will be back that is for sure!  Thank you!!

I highly recommend Noble Crust. Not only is the food excellent, but so is the staff. I placed an order thru Uber Eats and some weird stuff was happening and they kept switching drivers. After the 3rd driver I called Noble Crust to find out  what was going on. They immediately put a manager on the phone and informed me that my order was given to the initial driver and then they canceled picking it up. So Uber kept sending other drivers when the first driver actually stole our food. Meagan (Manager) and her staff at Noble Crust were extremely helpful. They immediately remade my order and I decided to just go and pick it up this time.

Customer service: 4 stars: caucasian manager on duty 3-2-2020 around 1130p was doing her best not to lose her sh*t with an inept staff but kept a friendly disposition. The cashier a caucasian girl was friendly and did her best to make sure our order was correct. Everyone else in there was dreadful. 

Cleanliness: 0 stars: the dinning area was do gross and we ate in the car. Its no way i would sit in there and eat. Based upon the dinning area i feared going to the restroom.

Price point: 2 stars: price point is steep for the portion size and quality of food. 

Food: 2 stars: got the wings with rice and beans and the gyro. My ol man said the wings werent crispy as they shouldve been. So basically a tad undercooked which could kill someone. The gyro was decent. They dont skimp on those. 

Overall: i wouldnt come back. Although visiting from out of town, if i was ever in the area again this place would never be an option. Sorry i wanted to like you guys and i overlooked a lot of things to give you business. Just wont be a repeat customer.

Tentatively I decided to try this restaurant having seen the 3* rating.   I guess I was hoping for at least average,  but it doesn't even rate average.   You get decent size portions of food I think they are just trying to get rid of.  The best part of the visit was the German beer selection.  I ordered saurbraten with sides of sauerkraut and spaetzle.  None of it could be any worse.   Everything tasted out of a package and severely overcooked.   The presentation was all together unappealing as the spaetzle was a mushy mess with the texture of rubber.   The saurbraten was tender but topped with a sauce that tasted like it came out of a foil envelope.   The sauerkraut appeared and tasted like it was out of a can.  Foolishly  after an unappealing dinner I went all in and decided to try apple strudel hoping dessert could salvage a bad dining experience and this only made things worse.   The strudel was not the least but flaky and sadly I began to wonder how many days ago it was prepared as it came across as a stale spongy pastry.   I don't know how much was paid as the tab it was picked up by one of the people dining with us, but he surely paid too much.   The entire meal came across as being prepared by a cook that is no longer inspired to cook food but is just going through the motions.   I cannot in good conscience recommend this restaurant.   I suggest you pass and find other options.

We've been meaning to come here for quite a while and finally did this evening. I'm only upset we waited so long to go!
Husband had the shredded beef tacos and I had the tri tip with potato salad and tots. The tots are so good. I am very picky about my potato salad but they're is among the best I've had. Maybe a smidge too dry but otherwise perfect. I ordered my tri tip medium and should have gone medium rare. I got 2 sauces the bbq and the A-25,. Both were awesome. 
My husband loved his tacos.
So 2 meals, a beer, a lemonade and dessert and we still didn't spend $45. Great deal!!!

Tried this spot for the first time tonight and was not disappointed. Grilled Shrimp Remoulade  Salad was amazing. Service was solid and the food came out quickly. Overall this place from food, service and atmosphere is awesome!
Very not kid friendly. Not sure if there is language barrier but you don't ask a crying toddler to go outside and calm down first.

Awesome place!!! I love the coconut shrimp, buffalo shrimp and the calamari. The food is excellent the sever was very polite, attentive and knowledgeable. I highly recommend this place. You will NOT be disappointed!!!

We dined at Al Pastor this past Friday night and had an enjoyable experience.  There was plenty of outdoor seating that was all spread out for social distancing guidelines.  The live music was excellent and created a positive environment.  Our server Micah did a great job, and he was attentive, friendly, and knowledgable about the menu.  My fiance and I ordered the chicken and cheese quesadilla as an app and the tropical guac (highly recommended).  They used to use chopped chicken in the quesadillas, which we preferred over their new shredded chicken, but they still tasted good.  The cauliflower tacos were amazing, as always!    All the food tasted great!  We will be back and love it here! :)

Very classy seafood place with an old time feel. It's higher scale (entrees range from $20-$60), and the quality wasn't too bad. Yelp had a deal for a free calamari appetizer which tasted quite nice. They were out of shrimp when I went so I had the daily special of the barramundi and it didn't quite well in my stomach. The service was excellent, very attentive and thorough. I also had their cookie box for desert, which was alright.

tried this place for breakfast and was so pleasantly surprised. i wish we found it sooner. Portions and prices are great. The chilaquiles were the best i've had. The espanol omelet was delicious. Al pastor tacos (highly rated in the other comments) lived up to the hype. Order was cooked quickly too!
The owner was very welcoming and mentioned they've been there for 18 years. We'll definitely be ordering from them again.

The guy who took our order was completely off with my meal. I told him One number 3 meal 8 count and he rang up 3 meals I told him multiple times that he was wrong and yet still did not take the extra meals off.

Ordered via the Yelp App/Grubhub deliver on a Tuesday night. Easy enough. Only real issue with the meal was no wasabi. Whether this was a mistake or their practice, not sure. So I'll let that slide. Sushi was pretty standard. Can't complain, can't rave. Average.

Got a to go order from this place -- fried Delacroix catfish with red beans, green beans and a side of gumbo. The guy that took my order sounded professional and his voice was clear. He said to be there in 15 mins so I was. My food was not ready (it took them another 12 minutes) which was odd since there was just 1 table and 1 go order before mine. Anyway while I was waiting I had a long time to observe that none of the cooks were wearing face masks, and only one of the 2 waitresses was wearing a face mask properly. The improper one, who had the mask resting on her chin, was not going to tables but she was interacting with ice, utensils, and other objects behind the counter. 

I collect my food and get home to eat. Everything looked decent enough so I started with the catfish. It was actually amazing. The fish was perfect, sauce great. Awesome flavor. Unfortunately the shrimp they also threw in there were TERRIBLE. They were rubbery, like they had been boiled for 30 minutes. Some of them had shells on still. Undeterred I cracked in to the Red beans. It was meh. Had a strange aftertaste but otherwise it was standard fare. The Green beans were also average. The gumbo was probably the worst gumbo I've had in a while. Like the shrimp, the meat in the gumbo tasted like it was cooked too long. IT was chewy and rubbery. The gumbo itself didn't really have a gumbo taste. 

Waitresses were friendly enough and the fish itself was great but everything else was bad bad bad. Strike anothe

I should say it's just OK without the A, (as in A-OK.) The first bad sign was the place was empty at 12:30 PM. The menu, from what I could tell was Japanese and Thai with a little Korean thrown in for good measure. That's never a good sign but you never know. I was intrigued. 
I had a series of small plates. First came a small bowl of spicy kimchi. It was good and actually spicy which was a surprise. Then came crab wonton, ubiquitous and not dissimilar to every other one you've ever had. Not bad. I ordered the vegetable croquets. Four panko fried patties of mashed potato served with an interesting tartar sauce, also not bad.
Lastly I had a cup (which was not a cup but a small bowl,) of Tom Ka Gai the Thai coconut milk soup with chicken, mushrooms, green onion and lime leaf. Also good.
If I was trapped by a storm or forced to meet friends there I'd go and it wouldn't be the worst thing in the world but that's hardly a compelling recommendation in a city with all the options we enjoy.
The only reason I tried it was because I went to eat the Halal Guys in Bellevue One and found they'd closed. The horror. I must find the next closest one and light candles until the next one opens hopefully on Charlotte as planned. (Insert praying hands emoji.)
Dao had a mixed seafood noodle dish I would like to try. Seafood noodle - that's my jam.

The 404 Kitchen is the epitome of fine dining in new Nashville! My party was greeted at the door by Katelyn, the most hospitable manager I've come across to date, we were seated on a gorgeous open air rooftop patio, and from there Chelsea serviced our every desire perfectly! With cocktails like the 404 signature Old Fashion, appetizers such as the Caeser salad and Fried Black Drum, and entrees of shared tri-tip steak you can tell the menu has been crafted with loving focus by Chef Matt! Even with as much food as my party ate, I'm so glad we tried desserts as well; they were a lovely, light cap to an unforgettable evening. I can't wait to be blown away by my next visit and their next culinary creations!

Way too much mayo in the bowls.

I see that this place has potential. I would definitely give it another shot as long as I'm monitoring the person making my bowl. The employee making it this time used way too much mayo - almost to the point of being inedible after eating half of it. I actually got a mayo headache. If I was rating this based on what I think it could be, I'd give it four stars, but based on my actual experience I have to give it three.

It seems like Oldsmar is the new place for the poke craze. We have Poke 88 down the road, not in Oldsmar, but close, and Poke Island Plus across the street. I pulled up the Yelp pages for this one and Poke Island Plus to decide where to eat.

A negative for both is it is very difficult to find the menu, on Yelp and otherwise. I tried to search for their actual websites and came up short. Poke Falls seems to also go by Poke Point and on their website it doesn't describe their signature bowls. It's all very confusing and wasn't a great start to the meal.

I sent my dad to just grab a variety of bowls since I had a work call. He came back with the Wild Salmon bowl in a sushi burrito form, Rainbow Poke Bowl, and Spicy Fish Classic Bowl. 

The prices are good, all are $11.95. I liked the ingredient combination and the chunks of fish, but like I wrote at the beginning, the overabundance of mayo ruined these dishes for me. The Wild Salmon burrito was the best because it didn't have a ton of mayo. 

I am a huge fan of the combinations s

I got a large Roast Beef And Special Italian.... the best I have had in a long time. The roast beef was pink & tender, with the perfect amount of lettuce, Tomatoes & Cheese. The Italian was the same way. Perfect amount of Meat to Greens. Plus, some Capicola to add some spiciness to the hoagie.

I love Panera food and I wish I could use this location, because it's just a mile from where I live. But I've been there around 20 times, always for Rapid Pickup, and there was only ONE time when they didn't make some sort of mistake with my order. I'm so tired of their incompetence. You must check every single thing before you leave. Once I thought they at last had everything right, started to walk away, and the bottom dropped out of my bag and all the order fell to the floor. Turned out they had spilled soup inside the bag and just left it to sit that way, so it soaked through the bag, which fell apart after I picked it up. Today I ordered the lentil soup and it was 99% broth, with just a few measly lentils at the bottom. I mean really--how hard is it to ladle soup right? I also paid extra to get the fresh fruit cup side and they gave me the baguette instead. Employees just don't care and don't read the orders. Complaints go nowhere, so it's ultimately a matter of poor management. 
From now on I'll just drive all the way to the next-closest location--Princeton--for my Panera orders.

Really enjoyed our lunch here. First time since the Covid. situation _ had a Stromboli
Sandwich - very tasty and a generous portion. My friend had the muffuletta and
enjoyed. it as well. I really miss the pizza by the slice but that has been discontinued for now. Very reasonable price for what you get.
One of my dear friends took me for dinner and it was amazing. It was a couple of months ago and I'm still thinking about it. Highly recommended.

The restaurant was half full and yet it took 40 minutes for us to receive our meal.  Then the tofu pad Thai had chicken and had to wait another 15 minutes for it to be fixed although they did ask us if we wanted them to pick out the wrong ingredient. 
The plates on the table were dirty and the table soy sauce was sticky and clearly hadn't  been cleaned for weeks.  The menu is a pared down menu so it's missing some of the favorites.  Very disappointing!

Wow, as I have depended on Yelp on my past vacation destinations, here we are again. In Clearwater Florida not knowing anything about Restaurants here and as I tell everyone we are going to let Yelp find us food, I took suggestions.  Pizza was the food of choice and sure enough this place was rated #1. It looked like a dive, not a bad thing, but more of a mom and pop place, but friendly,  clean and priced perfect, the food was even better. I had a hot housesteak sub, my family split a 18" pizza.  Nothing was left. It was totally amazing. We will be back again this week before we head back to San Antonio! We totally loved it!

My first visit to this restaurant and honestly I was not impressed. I ordered in the morning online asking for it to be ready at 6 o'clock. When I arrived at 5:30 they said they would start the order immediately since I had managed to get there early but I still did not get my order till about 6:20 PM. the staff was friendly and wearing masks and gloves but I noticed them pulling the masks down under their nose and mouth to talk. It is pretty expensive in my opinion. The food was OK nothing I would go back for. And after waiting all that time I got home short one order. I just didn't want to bother with going back and waiting a half hour for a bowl of rice. There was indoor seating and a lot of to go orders. Two people were working the counter. Was not able to see into the kitchen.

This breakfast experience was far from perfect. Although asthetically, the restaurant does not fail to impress with its goregous picture-perfect  lights and rustic barn style, there were major mistakes that that we could not ignore. The biggest mistake was the moldy berries that were served to us. Although we brought this to the attention of the server, she proceeded to bring us another plate that still had moldy berries. This was not the fault of the server, however, it was negligence on the part of those who worked in the kitchen. After replacing our fruit for the second time one of the other workers (aside from the server) approached us and implied that the berries were fine and made us point out the mold to her. Mold in fruit is dangerous because it seeps into the pores of the fruit. 
The pancakes were overcooked, to the point where there was black ash on them and they were extremely dry. It didn't help that we were not given enough syrup for both pancakes. The Californian dish came with hash browns which were served to us partially dangling off the plate. Lastly, the coffee was burnt. Thankfully, they replaced our coffee. Overall, based on my experience, this restaurant fails to deliver quality the first time.

Sarappos pizza is an outstanding establishment that fosters a family first dining experience and quality food. My experiences there have all been pleasant and rewarding. I find the $5 menu, daily specials, and warm disposition of the staff to be quite welcoming. The food is a step above your average pizza shop, and rivals that of finer Italian dining establishments!

Enjoyed happy hour at Wild River Grille this week.  They have a great location and pleasant staff.  Their menu has an excellent selection.  The Beet Salad was really good.  We had to ask for the Happy Hour Menu and it took the bartender a moment to locate one.  But overall, it was a good experience and I would go back again.  Can't wait for the warm weather to sit out by the river for happy hour.

Love how easy it was to eat healthy here! Salad with lamb was so good, fresh vegetables, dressing that added a ton of flavor without going over vinegary, and the lamb was cooked very well- just to a nice medium, and the marinade was delicious. I'll come back for sure, and try more of the menu!

Lovely date place with great flavors. The ambience is very nice and one of the best dates we have been on. A little pricier than our normal restaurants, but a Groupon helped somewhat. The veal involtini and curry seafood fettuccini were both delicious. The waitstaff is unique but likable. Our needs were attended to, and the dinner prompted great conversation. Would definitely come back.

This was an OK experience I asked for a Mamosa and they brought orange juice it was like frozen tasting and I didn't particularly like it. Had shrimp quesadillas which were overcooked. I don't think I'll go back because this is the second time I've been there
Small batch bbq sauce on high quality meat. Outstanding friendly service and a great menu!
THEY ARE OPEN. Please support this local family-run business. Their pastries and breads are bomb. Don't miss this spot.

My boyfriend and I love coming here and we do so frequently. I just wanted to share that the food was beyond exceptional today! We ordered the Smoky Mac(to share), he ordered the Bang Bang Flower tacos, and I got a Snootz Wrap. The Smoky Mac was creamy, the pasta was cooked perfectly, the sundried tomatoes provided some acidity, and the bacon tempeh took me to gastronomic heaven! I can't speak for the tacos but my boyfriend inhaled them, lol! He said they were on point. Last but not least was the Snootz Wrap; it was flavorful, filling, and the dill sauce gave it a"zing". Thank you guys for consistently making awesome food!
Best doughnuts in Philly. Their specialty: the apple fritter. But they're all phenomenal, particularly if you're a big glazed doughnut/Krispy Kreme fan.

My husband and I stopped here by chance one day when passing through. We fell in love. Since then, we've come 3 more times and even planned a trip to the area due to how much we loved the vibes and location. The food, margaritas and service never disappoints.

Heard really good things about this place. Stopped by tonight at 7:30 website said they close at 8 every night. We were told by the person at front desk only take out orders were being done. So we decided to try take out he directed us to the take out section. You could tell they were already shut down for the night. No food out everyone cleaning up. We could tell we weren't welcome here so we left. Don't understand why your website says your open til 8 when in reality it 7:15? Not sure I would give these guys a second chance. Really strange for a restaurant that just opened to be treating customers like this!

First time ordering from here. The menu looked really good. We waited 80 minutes for delivery which is fine. However the pizza was luke warm at best. The food was really good but cold pizza not so much.
Just amazing!!!  Their chicken tacos and tacos dorados are divine. And so is their guac!  A definite must!  We order from La Tentacion a lot.

I came here for the first time with my family on the 23rd. I was very disappointed. I wasn't sure what to expect and this may have been expectation vs reality. However, I am not a fan of huge stifling crowds. There was hardly any room to move. We brought our son in a stroller which made it incredibly difficult to get anywhere.

We decided we would try Raclette while we here because we had heard from friends that it was good. We waited in line for over 2 hours and In my opinion the price is a bit high. I didn't dislike the sandwich and the novelty of the melting cheese wheel being scraped onto the bread is cool. There were just so many people to serve and the cheese has to heat and melt between each sandwich. By the time we were done we were cold and tired and everything was closing down.

I don't think I would come back. You can tell everyone puts in a lot of work for this. I just do not enjoy crowds and waiting in lines. It is possible we just chose a bad day to go. If you don't mind these things then you will probably enjoy it.

First time in Nashville last week and saw the reviews for this place and decided to have lunch here. Driving through from Cincinnati to Houston,  I thought it would be a quick stop. But when we got there, the line was super long! This place must be good! They had umbrellas for the customers in line and a water dispenser to keep you cool and hydrated while waiting. Once we got in the door, we had to order and pay first and wait, again, to be seated. I ordered the Bill Neal, shrimp and grits, because I didn't want a heavy meal and be sleepy on the road and it was so flavorful and delicious. We also ordered the bonuts and oh my, that lemon mascarpone! So yummy! The hubby ordered the pork chop and eggs that had a side if biscuit. It was the best biscuit ever! Wish I could have ordered a biscuit meal as well but it gives us goals to go back and try other dishes. Happy with our selection and definitely worth the wait!

Totally a Santa Barbara local pizza spot.  It's got a cool medieval, tartan decor interior.  The individual veggie pizza is the best and a prefect serving size.  Absolutely awesome that you guys are open late, it makes shopping and running errands downtown so much more enjoyable.  Thanks guys.
Quick service, the shushi chef was about to go on break but stayed to make my dad and me some rolls. Super quick and very kind. Great sushi, not to much rice which in my opinion makes it better.

10/10 would recommend and will be back! We dined downstairs which was rustic with the exposed walls but also romantic with the dim lighting. It was a really cool experience down there. We started with the buratta and got both the gnocchi and lobster ravioli pastas, which were both incredible. We shared the Duck and roasted carrots. We could have gone without the carrots, as they could have been roasted a bit more until tender (that could just be a preference) but the duck.... the duck!  We could not get enough of it. The crispy skin was out of this world. I've been thinking about it all weekend . Our waiter was friendly, attentive and helpful with recommendations.

My fiance and I are so happy we found this place! We previously had a go to Chinese restaurant in Conshohocken but we regularly found the wait to be extremely long at dinner time so we decided to look elsewhere and we found Lucky Star!  They have a large number of options on their menu. 

I sat in the car while my fiance went to pick up the food. They had a table at the entrance of the restaurant for pick up.  When my fiance came back to the car the first thing he said was that the employee working the desk was genuinely really nice and he found that refreshing. He also mentioned that all the employees he could see were wearing masks appropriately.  We love when we see a restaurant taking the pandemic seriously.  We had chicken and broccoli with wonton soup and it was all perfect. I rarely finish my whole meal in one sitting but I finished this. The broccoli was perfectly cooked and their was plenty of sauce.  We both got white rice and also thought that was perfectly cooked.

I was here on Friday night and they told us there's happy hour going on if you sit at the bar or patio. It was a nice day out so we decided to do patio. It was pretty for late Friday night, there were about 4 tables. We ordered 2 cocktail drinks, 1 appetizer, and 2 rolls. First, the appetizer came, we finished while before the waitress to show up and asked how was it. We asked them about the drinks, she apologized. Then the food came out, we didn't have a mini bowl for the soy sauce so we asked for one. Then we wait and wait until we couldn't because we were so hungry so we just decided to start eating by putting the sauce on the sushi  approximately 25 mins later, a different waiter came with a mini bowl for the sauce when our plates were totally finished and told us that she was sorry, our waitress is busy right now, we saw she was just standing inside talking with other waiters!! After that we waited another 20 mins for to come so we could ask for a check. 
In a conclusion, food and drink were good but the service is bad.

This place is a mess. I've been eating here for about a year & the service just keeps going down. When you could go inside & order at the counter, you could at least keep an eye on the order & check it before leaving. 

Now, with drive-threw service only, my orders have been wrong, cold and items get forgotten. I have yet to have my order given to me at the window - they ALWAYS ask you to park and wait for your food. Someone walks it out, then walks away & you get to hope your order is somewhat close to what you asked for.

Yesterday I ordered, was given my change and was shorted $2 and change. When I called the girl on it, she looked at me like I had horns and asked me what I wanted her to do. Really?? 

I think I've given them enough chances to step it up & think it's time to skip McDs for a while.

Oh my goodness - LOVE THIS PLACE! I've eaten here twice, and the food was outstanding both times. I had the Empanadas appetizer, and it was absolutely divine. I've also had the Mountain Trout entree and the Regional Catch (red fish) entree, and both were delicious. The Bananas Foster pudding was also great. My friend and I both had some cocktails, though I don't remember the names, but they were also fabulous. No complaints! 
5 star service. 5 star food. 5 star drinks.

I visited November 7, 2019 and was immediately taken to my table, but from that point on the service was horrible. The waiter was super slow and there was hardly anyone at the restaurant. Our server only had 3 tables a total of 8 ppl. And every were complaining about the horrible service. 

When our food was finally delivered to our table my sausage was over cooked, the sausage was extremely dark, so I had to send it back. However when the replacement sausage arrived it was cooked properly and the rest of my meal was great. 

I know I won't be going to this location anytime soon. There's nothing worse than horrible service.

Love love this place.  Usually have a Thursday morning quiet time here but, of course, this virus is keeping us all home.  Ordered curbside coffees and sweets this morning.  They brought it out and put it in my car for me. Gloves on!  You all need to get here, if not now, when we're all back to normal.  They have breakfast and lunch.  They have wine and music in the evenings.   Check it out.
Really like this place. Drinks are always good, servers have been nice, and the French onion soup is awesome
Last time I was there the chicken was just ok what got me was the rice and red beans something I love it was horrible tasted mody what has happened to this place?

This is our go-to place in Chinatown. The food is always fantastic, and the menu is filled with so many outstanding options. The owner, Emily, is so nice and friendly and the staff is welcoming and helpful. Food is served fast, fresh and always delicious. Try the salt fried calamari, the beef hot pot, and the wonton soup. Also love the sautéed pea pod leaves. Amazing. This place is my absolute favorite.

First time visiting the Clam Tavern the staff is very friendly. I order the mussels crabs and pasta, the food is good could use more seasoning, old bay, fresh garlic and salt, but overall the space is tight and stairs for the female bathroom. The mix drink, Long Island ice tea pricey, $15 a small glass. I would return again and try a different selection of food.

A place I'd easily drive by and never notice, but sure glad I stopped in. We heard about this joint from a friend and we'll definitely be back. The food was incredible. Pictures attached are of Mongolia steak plate (spicy) and the spicy mandarian chicken. Both were tasty and extra spicy.

Just bought a vege-bowl, and Food here is great!
Both tastes great & good for you!
(BYOL - bring your own lettuce)

We loved the food at Martin's BBQ in Mt Juliet TN.  I posted a short review I did on it.  Food was good!

https://youtu.be/rg92ATuzy_w

Why 5 stars? Because if I lived nearby, this would be my go-to.

   ---   ---   ---

200+ reviews and a 5-star average? I need no other information. 

I don't find myself in Madeira Beach very often, but after scheduling a dinner in St. Pete Beach, I instantly added the 17-minute drive up Gulf Blvd to Haze Ice Cream to our itinerary. 

Madeira Mayor, Ginger L said that red velvet oreo is their best flavor, but was not an option on this particular night. I was quite happy to enjoy salted caramel and coconut in a waffle cone. 

The salted caramel was a bit more mild than others that I've tried recently. I was happy with it, but would have also been happier with a tad more saltiness. 

The coconut was the opposite - there were real chunks of coconut in it, which added to the experience. And the waffle cone was great, as always.

It may be a long time before I'm back for a second visit, but that's just due to proximity. If I lived nearby, this would be my regular ice cream fix!

Service was really fast, but it was 10:00 on a Thursday.   We just ordered chips and salsa and my daughter got the vegan burger and tots. She liked it. The chips and salsa trio was a little disappointing for $9. The salsa was okay. The chips were out of a bag, and just poured out onto a platter. Wish I didn't have to pay so much for them.   BL needs to work on the presentation. Salsa was okay. Not sure what jar it came out of. It was okay. Not my first choice. 

I'll give them 3.3 Bellies.

I can only speak to the carry out, I'm not sure we have ever eaten inside.  The food is delicious.  They may have the best avgolemono soup in town.  They have dinner specials and I love their spicy feta dip.

Stopped in for dinner. It's ok. We've had much better though so was disappointing after all the "high" reviews. Place was fairly clean. Service was sub-par. Food came out fast...before the soup or salads. Had to ask for refills more than once. The food wasn't bad, just not great. We probably won't be back.

My husband and mother in law are Cantonese. 
I NEVER expected to find a LEGIT delicious Chinese restaurant. It was so amazing. 

I am still dreaming about the bok choy with garlic. 

I thought the dumplings were made in house with care and love and we're just perfect. 
Wow. I wish this restaurant was in Austin. I would eat here everyday.

Lovely rooftop bar... the bar doesn't offer reservations but we are glad to have grabbed a seat as soon as we walked in around 5pm, the day before NYE. The drinks were complex and had the right strength. We were most impressed by the food. The burger alone was worth the visit and the shrimp toast was a must have. The duck poppers could use more duck meat but it was delicious nonetheless. Can't wait to revisit this place once COVID is over and try out more food and cocktails.

I miss eating in but they have taken every precaution available to protect their product and their customers!  This is still the best takeout in Pinellas County . Plus everyone is extremely friendly and courteous.

I used to work here about 30 years ago and the food was quite good back then. My family recently hit the drive thru for some burgers and tots and were sorely disappointed. I don't eat fast food but my kid brought me her half eaten burger and tots because she didn't enjoy them at all. She loves McDonald's though. Says a lot. I tried the food and it was bad. Tots were soggy yet greasy, cold, burger was nasty. I truly don't get the great reviews for this place. Once upon a time it was really good but now it seems they get by on location and hype more than anything. I heard In n Out burgers are coming to Boise. If you want a good burger, go there. The owner needs to ramp this place up, it's not good.

I'd been to Frothy Monkey and loved it... but that was pre-COVID. I'm from out of town, and honestly Nashville is generally as depressing now as San Francisco, where I'm from.   I thought a visit to Frothy Monkey could cheer me up. Bingo!!!my experience was amazing. Inside a lot of the tables are gone but you still get the vibe. The staff was friendly and service fast. And oh my coffee drink was heavenly, just what I remembered!  The outside seating is perfect for a meal so next time I'll get a bite to eat too.
Barf bags ahoy. This place is nasty and has microwaveable food. Obviously it was someone's vanity project. Surprised it is still in business.

"Pho"ntastic. Had the yummy oxtail soup today. So happy to have a great Pho closer to south Reno.  Thank you Mint for opening this restaurant.   Please come and support by eating welcoming the Mint to our neighborhood.   The Pho is delicious.

Yummy vermicelli pork salad and pork spring roll.  Service is amazing.   Still amazed to see it empty.  This place has great food.   Come check it out.

Everything was so great here! The staff was so friendly and was more than happy to give out recommendations and samples to help us order and create and AMAZING lunch! I was just blown away by how tasty the food was. The menu had more of a selection than I even expected, the portion size is more than plenty and the price is great! I will definitely be back and have already started telling my friends about it. I cannot believe that I didn't know about this sooner! They definitely make their food from the heart. I'm so glad that I tried this place!! Looking forward to the Cuban sandwich next time
Best kept secret in Doylestown.  Excellent food and Achilles is the best waiter I have ever experienced.

Honestly the brisket was delicious but bread was a little bit dry, not quite stale but they could have at least toasted it with butter or something, I felt like the ratio was a little off between meat and bread. 

That being said I have had their bbq in the past and the other items definitely slap, looking forward to trying again

I went to Bar Avalon this past weekend with my family. The hostess was friendly and we were greenly promptly by our server. The server Casey was very knowledgeable and explained all the specials to us and took our drinks. Our food arrived and it was really good. Our server made sure our food was exactly what we ordered. We got the special of the lemon cake that was recommended by our server it was soo good! We will definitely be back for good food and great service.

We went to Laser Wolf the week it opened and I was supremely impressed with the service.  For being a brand new restaurant I expected maybe one or two hiccups but no, it was some of the best service I've ever received at a restaurant. Knowledgeable, tentative but not pushy, and genuinely happy to be our server. 

The food was really delicious. Everything was extremely flavorful. Each bite was better than the next. I got the chicken and my husband got one of the lamb entrees. Highly recommend for a fun night out. Can't wait to go back! And the ice cream for dessert was the cherry on top.

its been a while since ive yelped and im glad to do this one , omgosh ! 
Best super papas ive ever have received from vivas at any location , i think at all restaurants honestly , 
Everything was crispy , crispy crispy bomb . Com ' !
I had no time for pictures i ate that plate quicker than a ...... oh nevermind

First time back since COVID and I am blown away once again. The menu has grown since the last time and there are great new additions. Had to get the crab curry, coconut rice, and tapioca dumplings, which were just as good as I remember. Tried the braised pork belly which was rich sweet and the meat was extremely tender!
The staff at Kalaya are so welcoming. Lindsay such a great waitress, accommodating and even hooked us up with complimentary Thai tea to cool our mouths from the heat!

This little establishment is doing a great job during these challenging times. They've got a bunch of tables out in the sidewalk and manage to serve quickly and with a friendly approach. We went for breakfast and waited for about 10 minutes. The only table available at the time was in full sun but we took it because we were  hungry. Good food. Good iced tea. Downside is the public walks through the dining area--many without masks. Loved the vibe and menu.

This was one of our date night staples before the remodel. It was closed for several months and we looked forward to the reopening with anticipation; however, we were extremely disappointed to discover that it had been transformed into a restaurant where you order at the front counter and no longer have a server at your table. While the quality of the food remains, we will only be visiting Siam Square for carry-out.

So, since moving down here to Santa Barbara from Santa Ynez, in October, I found my local Rusty's Pizza! I ordered all the time in Santa Ynez, so I had to find my local Rusty's here. We love Rusty's and we work all the time, so ordered from there frequently. Unfortunately, my last two orders within two weeks were awful, my second order that was awful, I ordered on January 19th. I had to call and ask what was happening. I spoke with a male supervisor at 9:44pm and informed him this was the second time our pizza was overcooked and hard. He stated they had a new oven and were adjusting to the heat in the oven. He was very kind and offered a $20.00 credit for our next order. 
I called tonight to order and use our credit. They supposedly had no record of a credit and kept questioning me like I was a criminal trying to play them. Very rude and unprofessional, they made no effort to find out who the supervisor was on Sunday and help. As a long standing customer, very disappointed - maybe work on your customer service and keep promises you make. I will Never order from Rusty's again.

Really wanted to try this place. Unfortunately after ordering my breakfast sandwiches I watched all of the unmasked workers and the young girl making my food handling frozen sausage and the croissant with no gloves and wiping her face and eyes as she made it. The manager was very responsive when I asked for my money back and did not hesitate. Also leaving gallons of milk on the floor not refrigerated is probably not a good idea- it was a very cute place though

As soon as we walked in we were seated with no wait. Although we were seated quickly, we waited about 10 minutes before we were approached by a server. He did apologize and thanked us for being patient which was very appreciated. He was very friendly and brought our drinks out promptly. Te table got an order of onion rings which was incredible as usual and our meals came out quickly. Throughout our feast our waiter made sure to check in and see that everything was tasting good and asked about drink refills. We all got the veggie burgers which were filling and tasty. The bottomless fries were amazing as well. We ordered the mud pie for dessert, but they were all out and we ended up getting the donut stack. Even though it wasn't our first choice, it was perfect! The donuts were warm and not too sweet. It was also a perfect serving size for the table to share. I love this place and recommend it to anyone.

This place was so much better than the previous review stated. Yes.... the food isn't the "best", but it was hot and fresh and they had a decent variety for brunch. The mimosas were straight champagne, no complaints though lol. I had a loaded Bloody Mary, super good and the bacon in it was AMAZINNNNN. We had a party of 15, accommodated well. The only thing is the "drag" portion isn't enough. 2 queens walked around for 1 song and tried to kind of interact but wasn't as great as we thought it'd be. I'd recommend to come here and experience, but that's just it. It's just an experience :)

Really great sandwich and hoagie spot. They have so many creative sandwiches and the traditional ones too.
And their sandwiches come with seeded rolls!! Love when a restaurant does that.
Didn't think of this as a brunch spot but gave the brunch a shot and it was fantastic, one of the best brunches we've had! I got the short rib Benedict which was amazing.

I ordered two lamb gyros  and an order of grape leaves.  Both were very good just a little slow and a little cold but that's to be expected with delivery.  The gyros were stuffed full of meat.  The grape leaves had good egg lemon sauce.  The place is spendy but worth it for delivery.

Pretty unfortunate that the guy running the lights made my wife and her friend feel so uncomfortable that they had to leave because we were too close to the lights. I understand you were upset because it was an expensive set up, but on top of that, you sent a tall guy with dreads over to try to intimidate us into leaving. Both of you should be seeking other jobs as you both don't understand how to handle people. The other bar security Professional was amazing and dealt with the situation professionally. You other two should be ashamed. Will not bring friends back here because obviously my wife and our friends were not welcome.

Charming well groomed bar.  Perfect atmosphere. We stopped in for a cool drink on a very hot night.  The restaurant was full after having been closed earlier the week.  The music was not too loud.  We were well taken care of by the staff in the bar. Charming and romantic French bar.

I'm never one to complain but if I'm going to pay $12 for a small smoothie and a LARGE soup I should get my money's worth.  The bowl may be bigger but come on it's barely half full.  There's even soup lines as if they put in more than that then scooped some out??  I even went to the counter to question if this is really how much should be in a large and the cashier told me it's just a bigger bowl and this is the portion..  if it's going to be like that don't charge so much when I could get the same amount of the same thing just as good in a can for a quarter of the price

Definitely a solid 4/5 for me. Chicken was flavorful and definitely much more moist than most jerk I've had here in Philly. The mango and jerk sauce were delicious. That being said $8 for a tiny container of Mac is a little excessive. Portions in general could have been a bit larger, but all in all it was a satisfying meal

I cannot say enough about this place. The food is beyond amazing. The options and flavors are amazing, I don't think I have been ever so happy after a meal, and satisfied with everything. Service was great and a call button at the table is an awesome idea, press and they are there no having to flag down someone. If you are looking for something delicious, Korean or just something new you haven't tried before stop in

As someone who would consider themselves to be a wing connoisseur, I can say these are the best wings I have had eaten in a while. And that's hard to say because I have eaten so many wings throughout this year (shoutout to quarantine). I appreciate the fact that this spot is open past midnight. This place has become my late-night snack spot. At Papa Bears Chicken, there are so many options to choose from in food. I was overwhelmed by deciding what meal I should get. So I ended up getting two meals . I ended up getting the honey spicy garlic wings and a burger. And y'all, I could've cried how good that food was. Honestly, I believe Papa Bears Chicken is so slept on to quality of chicken wings and good food. Not to mention, Papa Bears is a one-person business too. He is continually providing good food in such a reasonable time, keep in mind, still doing it all by himself. Give Papa Bears Chicken his props!

Service was really bad waited 15mins. Before someone came to take order waited another 10mins until we got our order mean while they did not give us any water we had to ask for water when thay gave us our food and they didnt give us knife so we can cut our food to ear as one of my kid ordered one of rice with pork. After all that pho was average pork was over cooked and burned will not be going back
Best pizza in town, pizza is delicious and staff was very nice. I ordered the cheese and it was warm delcious. Souderton is a great area for pizza but this one was the best.

I meant to update this a long time ago. CPK KoP contacted me after this review, apologized, and mailed me a coupon for a pizza. All of which went a long way toward fixing our relationship of trust and tasty pizza, and I've been a loyal customer ever since. Thank you CPK!

Made a reservation for my son's birthday. 6 of us. We had to wait in line FOREVER. The check in counter guys never acknowledge anyone in line. People just kept getting called via the intercom that their lane was available so they took care of them first. There should be a separate reservation line. Once we got to our lane it was fun. Shoes were cute and clean. We shared our area with a dad and son. It wasn't too bad. I had to use the bathroom. It was filthy and smelled like putrid urine and rotten fish. It was so gross. Definitely need a lot of work in that area. We ordered drinks and fries. The soda was on the flat side and the ketchup pump hardly worked. I literally took 10 minutes pumping for 3 tiny containers. The last thing that was really bothersome was the videos they play. I had 4 kids bowling and they show nasty twerking videos with chicks showing all their goods and extremely sexual. This bowling alley should keep in mind that families bowl too and should keep their choice of videos tasteful. We had a fun time but due to all the cons we would not come back. Hope my review helps you all. Have a good day!

The atmosphere was nice. The servers were great. I was disappointed that all of my food was just luke warm. We did not bring it up because I hate to complain. But everything we ate was just warm. It had good flavor but I love my food hot.

Love this place! Staff is at great as the food and coffee! Chorizo burrito is a generous size and so tasty. Slightly spicy but the salsa adds a little more kick if you want it. Mexican Hot Choco Latte was strong but not deadly and with just the right amount of cinnamon and mocha to complement your coffee without overpowering it. Absolutely delicious. Can't wait to go back and try some other stuff. From other customers' elated faces, their other stuff is just as good!

Incredible food from beginning to end. My friend and I were seated outdoors at a bar top table. We ordered the mussels, the loaded potato skins, and the lamb chops. The mussels were drowning in a delicious sauce with chorizo and there was a massive portion. The loaded potato skins were amaaaazing. It had the chewy on the inside, crispy on the outside texture with this delicious sauce. I'm not a huge fan of super cheesy things, and this was definitely on par with creamy but not cheesy. Also had a few surprising and delicious sweet potato skins in there too. The lamb chops were cooked tenderly and placed on top of an interested purée, which I didn't love, but the actual chops itself were cooked really well. Overall, everything was wonderful and I would definitely return to try their other other foods!

This review is for their king cakes only. And I almost don't want to write it because these king cakes are AMAZING, and I don't ever want to swing by and they're  sold out.  But, oh my lambs, they're just so damn god.  These king cakes have changed me.  and now I am selective and selfish consumer of king cake. I don't want to share their cakes, and honestly, I don't want king cake from anywhere else. I used to be a king cake lover. Like I'd eat them indiscriminately, grocery store, small bakery, wherever...alas. Tartine has ruined me.  First of all, omg...the brioche (is that what it is?) is so buttery and flavorful. It is perfectly delightful on its own. The filling to bread ratio is perfect. I'm so over these soggy wet king cakes. Tartine provides none of that tragic sadness.  These cakes are literally perfect.  They also satisfy my nostalgic traditional needs.  I love their crunchy sugar crystals.  They add a little texture to the king cake eating experience AND they aren't sprinkled with such reckless abandon that your teeth are stained purple and green when you finish eating. Let's address the flavor situation.  They have one option. And the flavor is called perfection, okay? Maybe these banana chocolate, honeysuckle blueberry and pineapple guava etc are delicious, but I love the simplicity of the Tartine flavor profile.  It's not too sweet, not too cinnamon flavored, nothing mass produced tasting.  Everything just melds together to showcases the high quality of their in

The good:

The service was great.  Our waitress was super nice and very friendly and attentive.  

The wings were really good.  

Onion load was good as well.

The disappointment......  the chicken.  My chicken was so dry I did not finish it.  The white meat was so dry I needed to drink beer to choke it down!

Tried ordering takeout was left on hold for 12 minutes. Got there placed my order was told it would take 20 minutes. Sat in my car bc there's not much seating with Co-vid going on. Came back in the restaurant after 10 minutes and my food was done. But it was old and thrown together. They'll never get my money again. Predominantly white patrons, don't expect good service if you are not white.

Wild eggs is a great breakfast place with a wide menu selection! Great atmosphere, food, and service! My favorite item on the menu is the chicken and waffles where they serve a waffle actually infused with little bits of spicy fried chicken along with the chicken wings/tenders in their signature spicy sauce. This downtown location is great. A tip for parking, mass ave is less than a block away and is generally not too full yet during their hours of operation.

One of my favorite go-to sushi burrito and poke places in town! The staff is wonderful and always so nice to me whenever I come in, the prices are fair, and the atmosphere is awesome.
My favorite burrito to get is the F-Bomb and my favorite poke bowl is the Rainbow! You can't go wrong with them! The poke bowl is packed and it seems like you get more for your money here than a lot of places that I go to.
I have been in during the COVID quarantine, and I'm so grateful to support their business during this time. They're all so wonderful there, please support them!

I go to Italy twice annually and this is the closest experience to authentic  Milan style pizza. Go in, have a personal pie, finish with a small coffee. Put off your post Italian trip depression... 

Prices are incredibly fair for the quality and experience especially when compared to places like Vetri Pizza. This is not your typical neighborhood pizza. It is about the flavors and passion that goes into making it. Buonissima!

We loved Talula's Garden! Right when you walk in, even before you walk in, you truly feel like you are in a high end garden. Then all decor on the inside from the walls to the doors to the plates, silverware, and menus all flow together cohesively to make you feel like you are in this intimate garden. VERY well done on the ambiance.

Cocktails: We had the beekeeper and the Farmer (both were very good). I liked the beekeeper in particular if you want something refreshing don't like super sweet cocktails. 

Cheese: 
World Travel - An Illustrious International Collection - This was so yummy! A little overpriced for how much cheese you get, but it was still fun and a cute little cheese board. The cheese was good too :)

Apps: We've actually been here twice now in 2 months, and the menu has changed a little. Both times, we got the Smoked Trout 'Caesar' Salad which was phenom. It is a little salty but not too fishy. Then the first time we went we got the brussel sprouts, which were SO good! I was so sad they were not there the second time. 

Entrees & sides:
Sweet English Pea and Arugula Risotto - My coworker said this tasted like baby food.. 
Beef Short Rib and Whipped Gold Potatoes - Coworker had this and loved it. 
Mediterranean Sea Bass - I am a connoisseur of sea bass, and this was very good. It was not the best I've had in Philly, but definitely in the top 3. 
Spatchcock Chicken - This was brand new on their menu as of this week and just overall great dish. It is so much chic

We brought a party of 9 for lunch and the atmosphere and food didn't disappoint!  The wine, hard liquor, and beer selections were extensive and I ended up having a satisfying Tank 7 Belgian beer.  We passed around a couple of hors d'oeuvres - nachos and pretzels were decent.  My lump crab cake burger was delicious and I'd definitely recommend it again.  Overall, this is exactly what I was expecting from the tap house and I'll give it a solid five stars.
Very nice and in the cut dessert spot. Prices are reaaaaally good and my mango crepe hit the spot. I WOULD DEF RECOMMEND

Katie's has been around a long time for a reason! Located in a more residential type area, there's not a huge buzz of people around. Except for everyone waiting in the line that's stretching out the door. If you go on a busy night, you might have to wait. But I always go anyway, because it's worth it!

Had a good pizza, we had the Da Vinci, good crust the only thing I would do different is, get a better quality prosciutto and use less chopped kalamata olives. They're open late which is great with this over blown pandemic, a lot of places close early.

Outstanding food and great service staff was very tentative to our needs friendly smile our server very outstanding was following detail Angelica the host remembered me from the last time and this is the 6th time that I am having this food! 5 star
    Mia was Outstanding as well
And Dave the Manager has been awesome as well!

I never got to try the food. Got seated outside, had two different waitresses walk by us a couple of times each. Sat there for 10 min. The hostess seated another couple next to us and we informed the hostess that we had not had a waitress come to us at all.  He went inside. One of the two waitresses that previously saw us sitting there walked past us to wait on that table!!! I was done at that point. Got up and left! Didn't want to give even one star! It's a Friday morning at 8:15 am and they weren't even busy!

We went for Valentine's Day and I tried their special...it was amazing! I'm happy I went with their picks for a special dinner.
It was expensive but worth it for a special night.

I ordered the bbq pork steak with fries. I liked the meat very much, it was tender and juicy! I also enjoyed the fries very much. Crispy outside and soft inside. In general I think this restaurant worths more than 3.5 stars, so i give 5 stars to pull it up a bit. 

PS. Service was nice and friendly.

We stumbled upon One World Market and only sampled 1 item on their menu but bought several drinks and candies.  What a selection this place has!  Wines, noodles, and sauces: Oh My!

We will be back to try more kitchen items and to get the Spicy Bomb Inari again. Their prices are very reasonable.
Great local spot.  They work hard to make it an enjoyable lunch. So glad to have this local option.
They cancelled our order places over an hour ago and their phone number rings 6 times then gets a FAX tone, so I dont know how to reach them.

So we've been in this restaurant around 11:30a and all we freaking got from our order were the apetizers , so I waived my hand to get the attention of the server and she just looked at me, then 15 mins later a server past by and I talked to her and told her whats going on she sent someone else to our table. We've been here for more thn an hour and havent gotten sushi, the people next to use and in front of us had gotten their orders and they came like 30-45 mins after us. Spoke with the manager and they didn't do nothing about it.

So I tried this restaurant last night and it was phenomenal. I love Thai food and this was an unexpected but phenomenal find. We ordered four different dishes and loved them all. 

I ordered the Pad see ew, curry, crispy chicken and pd woo sen. Again, everything tasted great and it was such a neat find. I hopefully will be able to go there in person to try their food. 

Additionally, When you ordered on door dash They did allow for some customizations of the dishes which was really nice because I do you like certain things on and off my dishes when I eat Thai food. 

Again, I highly recommend this place.

This places rents out the kitchen of Velvet Jones, which I don't even think is a live venue anymore, much less open. The actual Velvet Jones wasn't open when I visited in June, but this delicious mac and cheese front was.

The mac and cheese here is pretty decent. A fast food equivalent would be like El Pollo Loco's mac and cheese. The mac and cheese is best eaten here fresh like within 15 minutes, because otherwise the cheese gets weirdly gloopy/chunky in consistency rather than creamy/sticky. The noodles are pretty big and fall apart easily and the tater tots are fantastic (the vegetarian option has tater tots underneath the mac and cheese and omg).

The build-your-own small starts at $6. I got mine just plain for $6 and thought it was pretty worth it.

My friend ordered the vegetarian one without jalapenos. It normally comes with tomatoes, jalapenos, and basil, but they totally forgot the basil and we didn't realize until we got home (it was wrapped in foil to-go). The large was definitely a big size, but not sure if worth about $12. Would highly recommend this hole-in-the-wall (almost literally) to any mac and cheese lover with a night-time craving, though. Seems like tax is included in the listed price, which is a bonus.

So far the best Indian lunch in Ybor area. Perfect price quantity and outstanding quality. Please don't change. I will be coming back here more often for lunch. Thank you for a very delicious and reasonable Indian cuisine option in the Ybor area!
Great drunk pizza. Depending on the time of day, great New Orleans flop. It's Not fancy pizza, but it's football pizza. It's just hard to justify eating pizza while in New Orleans. 7.6

You might first think, tacos and coffee, what a combo? But this place is the best of both worlds! The tacos are fabulous and the coffee is extremely flavorful. Perfect way to perk up your morning or lunch break! Plus, being available on Door Dash & Grub Hub is a plus for me. I suggest getting dressing on the side if you opt for a salad - they definitely overload the dressing.

Okay. So let me start saying that every time I have sushi somewhere else, I compare it to the sushi here and there is no comparison.   It is ALWAYS fresh and delicious.  Everyone is nice and they work so hard to make sure food is good, fresh and service is on point.  If you are looking to get sushi in the area, look no more! :)  My husband does not like sushi and he looovees their house fried rice.

Good bbq but nothing really out of this world.  Brisket was tender but not very tasty without the help of bbq sauce which was just OK.  The pulled pork was better than the brisket but the real stand outs were the beef sausage which was the tastiest item on the menu and the mac and cheese.

Recently I wrote a review re: their corned beef sandwich wonder " where's the beef). The owner responded with his phone number. 
Went back to Wright's today and had my usual turkey club, Husband had a grilled Cuban and our friend the BLT. Wonderful! We all had half left for our dinner.
When we returned home I called him back and told him we were there today and everything was exactly as it should be, but didn't have the corned beef. He was very gracious and said he would look into it.
I will give Wright's the five star rating it deserves because in all the years we've been going there that has been the only problem we've ever encountered. 
PS there is also a woman who works at helping to clean the tables. She is a GEM! She was working today. Friendly and a super smile. Jeff give her a raise!

This is one of my favorite places to go for a casual dinner. Plus, its BYOB! Great cypriot style Greek food. I usually get the platters with whichever meats I'm feeling that night. The trio of dips is a great shareable item in the beginning and I tell everyone who is going that they must try the baklava!!! I do not have a sweet tooth at all but I think about their baklava from time to time.

The numnuts who work here are literally dumber than rocks. They will mess up your order no matter what you order, every single time, even if you're the only customer there. I think you have to have had a lobotomy to be hired here. Probably the worst McDonald's in the entire country.

I had to throw my entire meal out because it was completely incorrect. If you are dumb enough to go here you need to unwrap every single item of food before you drive away. No one who works here can read English so there's no way to know if they got your order right or not.

I'm giving 3 stars for the inconsistent and offensive tiffin policies and pricing. They now advise they do not offer tiffin takeout which is disappointing for a solo diner who doesn't want a big buffet but wants variety. I used to be a twice weekly customer. It's the way you communicated it to me as well. The food is good, no doubt about it. That's why I was a customer but there are several other good Indian food places which offer tiffen and don't scold you for asking for it.

We've eaten here and at the Eagle location a few times, and the food is consistently good. The waffle is my favorite breakfast choice by far. Husband would prefer a bit more punch to both versions of the Bloody Mary (reg & spicy) and the chorizo sausage, but there's a theme to his comments. The mimosa is excellent.

When someone invites you to Texas Roadhouse the answer is always a yes. I can't get enough of the butter and rolls. My steak was perfect and the mash potatoes was good. I don't know why i always get the strawberry margarita and forget that I dont like the syrup. 

We did the call ahead seating and waited about 45 minutes before our table was ready which is normal for there. The service was excelling our server was overworked they could have more servers during the week because she was running all over the restaurant. 

Overall everything was good.
